sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, Histaklut Penimit 10

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, Histaklut Penimit 10:1
items.html:
It explains the Partzuf AB of AK, and it contains four matters: 1. That the direct light and reflected light purify the screen of phase four to phase three, and the upper light, which never ceases to shine, struck it, and the screen raised reflected light and clothed the ten Sefirot of direct light up to Chochma. And this is called AB of AK. 2. There is no partiality in spirituality, and therefore before it received the coarseness of phase three, it had already been purified entirely, up to the root. 3. This purification to the root is called the ascent from the Tabur to the Peh. 4. After the screen acquired the coarseness of phase three while at its root in the Peh of Galgalta, it returned and descended to its place, to the place of the Chazeh of Galgalta of AK, and there was made upon it the coupling by striking, and from the Peh (the Chazeh) of Galgalta of AK downward emerged the RTS of the Partzuf AB of AK.

The surrounding light purifies the screen of phase four to phase three
You already know the law of purification that operates in the coarseness within the vessel of Malchut: although the coarseness within the vessel of Malchut is what draws down and causes the entire stature in the Partzuf, still, once the upper light has been drawn there and has clothed the Partzuf, it is in the nature of the surrounding light to purify the coarseness within Malchut (as explained well in the Inner Light, Part 2, item 72, s.v. "and so that"). And therefore, after the upper light clothed the Partzuf Galgalta of AK, as above, it caused a purification of the coarseness of phase four in the screen within its Malchut, and because of this a new screen emerged in Malchut, of phase three.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, Histaklut Penimit 10:2
items.html:
The emergence of the ten Sefirot of the Rosh at the stature of Chochma, upon the screen of phase three
And since the upper light never ceases to shine to the emanated for even a moment (as the Rav writes in Etz Chaim, Gate 6, Chapter 7, section 4), it follows because of this that at that very moment when the screen was renewed with the coarseness of phase three, immediately the light of Ein Sof extends to it for the coupling by striking, whereby Malchut raises reflected light and clothes the upper light. But because the measure of coarseness of phase four was lacking, the reflected light, repelled and rising from Malchut, was diminished from its former measure, and does not now reach to clothe up to the stature of Keter as before, but only up to the stature of Chochma.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, Histaklut Penimit 10:3
items.html:
The stature of Chochma is set apart as a Partzuf in its own right, and is called AB of AK
You already know that just as physical things are separated from one another by distance of place, so spiritual things are separated from one another by a change of form that arises within them, the measure of the distance being gauged by the magnitude of the change between them. And therefore, once the screen of phase three emerged and was renewed within the Partzuf Galgalta of AK, together with the new stature of light, this change of form separates and sets apart this new stature as a distinct category in its own right. And therefore we regard this new stature as a second Partzuf of AK, called the Partzuf AB of AK, whose stature reaches only up to Chochma, as explained.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, Histaklut Penimit 10:4
items.html:
AB of AK emerged from the coupling by striking upon the screen of phase three, which was made in the Peh of the Partzuf Galgalta of AK
And it has now been explained that the cause and reason for the emanation of the second Partzuf of AK is the law of purification, which always operates in the coarseness of the screen within the vessel of Malchut, because of the clothing of the upper light. Therefore, after the clothing of the upper light in the first Partzuf of AK, called Galgalta, was completed, the coarseness of phase four within the screen in Malchut was purified to the measure of the coarseness of phase three. And this coupling by striking, made upon the screen of phase three that rose to the Peh of Galgalta of AK, emanated the second Partzuf of AK at the stature of Chochma, called the Partzuf AB of AK.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, Histaklut Penimit 10:5
items.html:
The purification of the coarseness within the screen down to the coarseness of the root is regarded as an ascent to the Peh of the Rosh
However, the intention is not that immediately after Malchut was purified from phase four and stood at the coarseness of phase three, the Partzuf AB was emanated and emerged there, for there is no such thing as partiality in spirituality, and it is not possible at all for part of the coarseness to be purified from Malchut while part of the coarseness remains in Malchut. Rather, once Malchut began to be purified, it must go on being purified of all its coarseness, until it stands in complete purity, which is its root, where the light of Keter clothes, as above (Chapter 6, item 4); see there. And know that this matter of purification down to the root is called by the name of the ascent of Malchut to Keter, or the ascent of the Tabur to the Peh of the Rosh, for the Peh is the Keter of Malchut, and the Tabur is the Malchut of Malchut (as above, Chapter 7, item 4).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, Histaklut Penimit 10:6
items.html:
Ascent means purification, and descent means coarsening
And here you must remember that ascent means purification, and descent means coarsening, and the purer a thing is, the more it is regarded as higher. And the matter of the standing of the ten Sefirot — Keter, Chochma, Bina, ZA, and Malchut of the Guf of the Partzuf — one above the other, from the Peh to the Tabur, does not refer, God forbid, to an imagined place, but only to a matter of purity and coarseness alone, in such a way that Keter, being the purest vessel of all, is regarded as standing next to the Peh of the Rosh of the Partzuf, that is, highest of all. And Malchut, which is the coarsest of all, is regarded as standing below, at the place of the Tabur of the Guf of the Partzuf, that is, lowest of all.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, Histaklut Penimit 10:7
items.html:
The equalizing of the lower one's form with the upper one is regarded as arriving at the place of the upper one
And with this you will simply understand that when we say that Malchut went and was purified of the coarseness of phase four within her, until she remained as pure as her root, it follows because of this that she truly arrives at the place of her root, namely her Keter, called the Peh; for by being as pure as it, she is found to be with it at one and the same level.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, Histaklut Penimit 10:8
items.html:
After the screen ascended and was included in the Peh of Galgalta, coarseness was renewed in it, except for the final phase
And therefore, at the time when Malchut is purified completely and remains at the degree of the root, she is found by this to have ascended to her emanator, namely to the Peh of the Rosh, because the level of the Peh of the Rosh is the root of this entire preceding expansion from above downward, and she is included there in the coupling by striking that operates in the Malchut of the Rosh. And therefore Malchut is found once more to return and receive again for herself the measure of coarseness that was in her at first, before she was purified, except for the final phase, which is lost and does not return, because the final phase does not leave a Reshimo, as explained elsewhere; so that through this inclusion in the coupling by striking in the Peh of the Rosh of Galgalta, she received only the coarseness of phase three alone. And there emerged from it the ten Sefirot at the stature of Chochma.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, Histaklut Penimit 10:9
items.html:
The emergence of the ten Sefirot of the Rosh of AB, and its descent to the place of the Chazeh of Galgalta
And after the screen was included in the coupling by striking in the Peh of the Rosh of Galgalta, and the coarseness that had been in it returned and was renewed, it became recognized that the coarseness in it is the coarseness of the Tabur, which is below the Peh of Galgalta, and has no connection to the Peh of Galgalta. And this recognition is regarded as the screen separating from the Peh of the Rosh of Galgalta and emerging from it, and descending — that is, coarsening — to the coarseness of phase three in the Guf of Galgalta, called the Chazeh. And since it was already included with the screen of the coarseness of the Rosh, from the time it was in the Peh of Galgalta, once again the light of Ein Sof extended to it for the coupling by striking, even while it was at the place of the Chazeh, and there emerged upon it the ten Sefirot of the Rosh at the stature of Chochma. And it is lacking Keter, because a screen with the coarseness of phase three draws down only the stature of Chochma. And these are called the Rosh of the Partzuf AB of AK. And so it is found that the source of the ten Sefirot of the Rosh of the Partzuf AB of AK emerged in the Peh of the Partzuf Galgalta of AK, that is, at the time of the inclusion of the screen in the coupling by striking in the Peh of Galgalta. And afterward they descended from there to the place of the Chazeh, and from the coupling by striking made at the place of the Chazeh, there emerged ten Sefirot at the stature of Chochma, and they clothed Galgalta of AK from the Chazeh upward, up to next to the Peh of Galgalta, that is, up to the Chochma of the Guf of Galgalta, and not to the Peh itself. For the Peh is the Keter of the Guf of Galgalta, and the Rosh of AB is lacking Keter.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, Histaklut Penimit 10:10
items.html:
The order of Sof of the Partzuf AB of AK
And afterward that reflected light returned, and expanded Malchut into ten Sefirot from herself and within herself, from her downward to the Malchut within her, and here there emerged the ten Sefirot of the Guf, as above, called the ten Sefirot of the Toch. And from there downward, the ten Sefirot of reflected light without direct light expanded, which are the female light, that concludes the degree, as above. And thus has been explained: Rosh, Toch, Sof of the Partzuf AB of AK.
